title: Payment authentication method mismatch
old_claim: Payment Service authenticates internal service calls using signed JWT tokens.
new_claim: Payment Service internal calls now use OAuth2 client credentials, with JWT only for legacy read-only endpoints.
recommended_update: Update the Payment Service Architecture document to state that internal service calls must use OAuth2 client credentials. Keep JWT documented only as a temporary legacy path for read-only endpoints until September.
business_impact: Engineers may build new integrations against the deprecated JWT path, creating security and rollout risk.

title: Deployment cadence changed
old_claim: Production deployments happen every Friday at 6 PM.
new_claim: Customer-facing deployments now happen Tuesday and Thursday at noon.
recommended_update: Update the Deployment Checklist with Tuesday and Thursday noon release windows while preserving mandatory QA sign-off.
business_impact: Teams may wait for the wrong release window or schedule customer work around an outdated Friday deployment process.

title: Enterprise onboarding ownership changed
old_claim: Customer Success owns enterprise onboarding after contract signature.
new_claim: Implementation Squad owns onboarding for enterprise customers above Rs. 25L ACV.
recommended_update: Update the onboarding SOP to assign high-value enterprise onboarding to Implementation Squad from kickoff to go-live, with Customer Success owning relationship health.
business_impact: High-value customers may experience delays because ownership is unclear between Customer Success and Implementation Squad.
